newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 27.

text.p: Ford Motor Co started selling two new models in Japan by cutting the prices of its passenger car "Mondeo" by four percent and its "Explorer" recreational vehicle by six percent. Ford aims to expand its market share in Japan by cutting prices of the vehicles despite the dollar's recent gains against the yen.

Japan's five leading advertising companies, including Hakuhodo Inc and Dai-Ichi Kikaku Co Ltd, and Internet-related venture company Digital Garage Inc, are planning to set up a joint venture specialising in Internet advertising on Devember 2. The company, capitalised at 120 million yen, will aim for sales of more than 500 million yen in its first year.
